nodes.label: NewEra Logo (Dark Theme)
nodes.description: Dark-background variant of the NewEra365 brand logo. White bold sans-serif wordmark 'NEWERA' on a near-black background. The letter 'N' incorporates a green candlestick chart icon (two candlesticks, one green-filled), reinforcing the forex/trading brand identity. Used in the web frontend for dark mode or dark-background contexts.
